items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Al Rinker -- is that his name? Used to be with Bing Crosby and Harry Barris when they were with Paul Whiteman?

ctx.x: Well, I was playing little off brand shows, you know, like they had a talk show, a comedy show, called The Three Rs, and Al Rinker -- is that his name? Used to be with Bing Crosby and Harry Barris when they were with Paul Whiteman? Well, he was Mildred Bailey's brother. He was the engineer on this show, and Joe [Rhines] was the conductor. He came out here and worked at NBC when it was on the corner of Sunset and Vine. And Irving Miller was there at NBC in New York. He came out here and worked at NBC.
But did you go over to NBC and apply, or did they come -- did someone you knew tell you there was a job or what?
